video_title: POSTGAME SOUND: ORLANDO MAGIC VS. BOSTON CELTICS | COACH SWEENEY,  DESMOND BANE, & ANTHONY BLACK

quotes.speaker: Coach Sweeney
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Sweeney on the Magic's fourth-quarter execution and competitiveness
quotes.excerpt: I thought our competitiveness and our effort on both ends was phenomenal.
quotes.quote: I thought just in general we did a great job of attacking. 40-point quarter, did a great job of handling their pressure at the end, the traps, trying to foul. So a great job there of staying with it, but I thought our competitiveness and our effort on both ends was phenomenal. Desmond got it going there, did a great job of attacking, making the right play, the ball was being shared. Just overall, a great quarter from a number of guys contributing.
quotes.social_post: Coach Sweeney on the Magic's 40-point fourth quarter against Boston: I thought just in general we did a great job of attacking. We did a great job of handling their pressure at the end, the traps, trying to foul.

structured.context: Coach Sweeney discusses the team's fourth-quarter performance and effort against the Boston Celtics.

quotes.speaker: Coach Sweeney
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Sweeney praises Jalen Suggs' offensive rebounding and extra possessions
quotes.excerpt: Jalen's two offensive rebounds, big-time extra possession plays, made a big difference.
quotes.quote: I think the one thing I want to highlight is Jalen's two offensive rebounds, big-time extra possession plays, made a big difference, helped us out a lot.
quotes.social_post: Coach Sweeney highlights Jalen Suggs' impact: I think the one thing I want to highlight is Jalen's two offensive rebounds, big-time extra possession plays, made a big difference, helped us out a lot.

structured.context: Coach Sweeney highlights the impact of Jalen Suggs' offensive rebounding during the game.

quotes.speaker: Coach Sweeney
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Sweeney on Jalen Suggs' clutch mentality and competitive nature
quotes.excerpt: His competitiveness is so high, his toughness is so high, and he's such a team guy.
quotes.quote: I think who he is as a person, his competitiveness is so high, his toughness is so high, and he's such a team guy. When it comes to those big moments late, he does a great job of not shying away from anything. He wants to be involved, wanted the primary matchup, wanted to guard big-time players, wanted the ball. I think that want-to and that competitiveness was really apparent tonight, especially late.
quotes.social_post: Coach Sweeney on Jalen Suggs' clutch mentality: When it comes to those big moments late, he does a great job of not shying away from anything. He wants to be involved, wanted the primary matchup, wanted to guard big-time players.

structured.context: Coach Sweeney praises Jalen Suggs for his competitive nature and clutch performance late in the game.

quotes.speaker: Coach Sweeney
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Sweeney on the team's defensive physicality and limiting Jayson Tatum
quotes.excerpt: Did a much better job of keeping Jayson Tatum off the line, not allowing him those opportunities.
quotes.quote: We talk about being physical without fouling. I think they only had 17 free throws. Did a great job with that, did a much better job of keeping Jayson Tatum off the line, not allowing him those opportunities, and I think just in general we did a great job of attacking the play, limiting their offensive rebounds and free-throw opportunities.
quotes.social_post: Coach Sweeney on the defensive game plan against Jayson Tatum: We did a much better job of keeping Jayson Tatum off the line, not allowing him those opportunities, and limiting their offensive rebounds.

structured.context: Coach Sweeney explains the defensive strategy used to limit Jayson Tatum and the Celtics at the free-throw line.

quotes.speaker: Desmond Bane
quotes.summary_phrase: Desmond Bane on the Magic's resilience and sticking to their process
quotes.excerpt: The sign of a good team, a resilient team, is a team that stays with it.
quotes.quote: The sign of a good team, a resilient team, is a team that stays with it, and the process looks the same throughout the entire game. It's just whether you're making or missing shots, you know, who determines whether or not you kind of go on that run. I thought that we did it for the majority of the game. Our defense gave us a chance, and then that fourth quarter we kind of broke it open offensively.
quotes.social_post: Desmond Bane on the Magic's resilience: The sign of a good team, a resilient team, is a team that stays with it, and the process looks the same throughout the entire game.

structured.context: Desmond Bane reflects on the team's resilience and consistency throughout the game against Boston.

quotes.speaker: Desmond Bane
quotes.summary_phrase: Desmond Bane on handling Boston's defensive pressure and finding spots
quotes.excerpt: They were putting so much pressure on Franz, putting pressure on AB, Jalen Suggs.
quotes.quote: They were putting so much pressure on Franz, putting pressure on AB, Jalen Suggs. So I was just trying to find my spots, give them space, and whenever they drove and collapsed the paint or coach drew up a play, I was aggressive to go score.
quotes.social_post: Desmond Bane on his role against Boston: They were putting so much pressure on Franz, AB, and Jalen Suggs. So I was just trying to find my spots, give them space, and whenever they drove and collapsed the paint, I was aggressive to go score.

structured.context: Desmond Bane describes his role in finding scoring opportunities while Boston pressured his teammates.

quotes.speaker: Anthony Black
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Black on the team's defensive physicality against Boston
quotes.excerpt: I think we just did a good job taking the fight to them on that side.
quotes.quote: I think we just did a good job taking the fight to them on that side of the ball. Like Desmond said, it was a real low-scoring first quarter, and we know that plays in our favor. So I think we just did a good job being physical, blowing up their actions. We had a good game plan coming in, and for the most part, we executed.
quotes.social_post: Anthony Black on the defensive effort against the Celtics: We just did a good job taking the fight to them. It was a real low-scoring first quarter, and we know that plays in our favor. We just did a good job being physical.

structured.context: Anthony Black discusses the team's physical defensive approach against the Boston Celtics.

quotes.speaker: Anthony Black
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Black on creating quality shots through paint penetration
quotes.excerpt: Different players getting into the paint causing a problem, demanding more than one body.
quotes.quote: Different players getting into the paint causing a problem, demanding more than one body. And then from there, we've been watching a lot of film on making the right play in the paint and being in the right spots. It's just a good job of all of our handlers making good plays, making the extra pass. Obviously Jayson Tatum, Franz, Desmond Bane, myself, we get into the paint a lot. So as many times as we make good decisions, we feel like we get good shots and put ourselves in a good spot to win.
quotes.social_post: Anthony Black on the team's offensive philosophy: Different players getting into the paint causing a problem, demanding more than one body. As many times as we make good decisions, we feel like we get good shots.

structured.context: Anthony Black explains how the team creates quality shots through paint penetration and ball movement.

quotes.speaker: Desmond Bane
quotes.summary_phrase: Desmond Bane on the team's confidence in defending the three-point line
quotes.excerpt: We're confident that that we can do the same on on our end of the floor.
quotes.quote: Like Anthony Black said, I thought we had a great game plan being super aggressive, trying to take some of those looks away from them. But, you know, we're confident that that we can do the same on our end of the floor. It's not like we're walking in like, oh my gosh. It was more so like, let's, you know, take them, try to run them off the three-point line and be solid when we do rotate, like we do every night, and we'll give ourselves a chance. We got a good team.
quotes.social_post: Desmond Bane on defending the perimeter: We're confident that we can do the same on our end of the floor. It was more so like, let's try to run them off the three-point line and be solid when we do rotate.

structured.context: Desmond Bane discusses the team's defensive game plan to limit Boston's three-point shooting.

quotes.speaker: Desmond Bane
quotes.summary_phrase: Desmond Bane praises Jalen Suggs' impact and winning mentality
quotes.excerpt: He's a winning player. You can kind of plug him in with any lineup.
quotes.quote: That was a Jalen Suggs game right there. I mean, offensive rebounds, blocked shots, getting in the paint, knocked down a couple big threes. Like that's that's him. He's a winning player. You can kind of plug him in with any lineup and he's going to find a way to impact winning. I thought he did that at an extremely high level tonight.
quotes.social_post: Desmond Bane on Jalen Suggs: That was a Jalen Suggs game right there. Offensive rebounds, blocked shots, getting in the paint, knocked down a couple big threes. He's a winning player.

structured.context: Desmond Bane praises Jalen Suggs for his high-level impact and winning mentality during the game.

quotes.speaker: Anthony Black
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Black on the team's progress in maintaining leads on the road
quotes.excerpt: Playing on the road with staying in runs, maintaining a lead and getting a lead.
quotes.quote: I think it's just a good step for us. Just as time has gone on for our team, that's been an area where we knew we could get better, playing on the road with staying in runs, maintaining a lead and getting a lead. And you know, I think today we just took a big step forward. As a team, I feel like we were really poised down the stretch, even when they started making their shots, and yeah, we just stuck with it. We came together, you know, we're in constant communication out there, and we just did a good job coming together, staying together, and getting out a good win on the road.
quotes.social_post: Anthony Black on winning on the road: As a team, I feel like we were really poised down the stretch, even when they started making their shots, and yeah, we just stuck with it. We came together and we just did a good job.

structured.context: Anthony Black reflects on the team's progress in maintaining leads and playing with poise on the road.
